column1: # THE NORMALIZER'S SECOND BATCH, ITEM 0: 66 KEYS ADDED TO rust/oracles/identity/hits.tsv, ATTRIBUTED (2026-11-15;
# docs/rust-port/PHASE3.md, the normalizer slice's entry, "the normalizer's second batch"; PHASE3_SHIM_DESIGN.md section
# 10 rulings 34 and 37 (a)). Two complete probe v2 runs at 1615cfa4c (NB2Z1, NB2Z2: each its own tagged copy of
# rust/tools/identity-hits-probe-v2.patch, every hunk checked to apply before the run; 143 of 145 targets passing each,
# the two probe-caused failures //core:census and //core:guardrails) answered all 73,413 frozen keys, all equal, none
# moved or absent, and agree on each of these 66 keys, which no frozen key was, outside the freeze's by-design exclusions
# (the Postgres lanes' and the temporary-path models', //core:ladder_report's 24) -- the same 66 the first batch's two
# runs at 47d13b73f answered and left out (namesland/refreeze3.py, its dry run byte for byte the first batch's). Each
# key is matched to its test text by the probe's own model id (port-scratch/normbatch/keymap: t: the text's SHA-256,
# s: the sources' "m.pure" NUL text). None has a MirJson id, an execution plan id or a test plan id, so mir-ids.tsv,
# plan-ids.tsv and rust/oracles/mir are unchanged (re-derived byte for byte). 63 keys are corpus growth: the texts the
# normalizer slice's step 1 (26 keys: RefusalsNotCrashesTest's 14 texts, their 14 module builds and 11 compiles, and
# TRANSLATED_SHAPE's bodies compile) and the first batch (37 keys) added to core/src/test; 3 are the bodies compiles
# of three slice texts that the first batch's item 4 (d), 47d13b73f, newly lets a strict build compile (an
# association's NotImplementedException deferred in both builds). Columns: item, commit, oracle file, kind, model,
# query, doors, use, the text (test class and field), why the key is new.
